items.t: In the SnapStats data the row is named simply "Grandview", one of nine sub-areas of the Fraser Valley board community "S Surrey White Rock". Morgan Crossing, the retail village at 24 Avenue / 160 Street, sits inside Grandview and its homes use this Grandview board row; Morgan Creek is a different sub-area with its own row, never used for Grandview.

City planning frame: the City's approved South Surrey land use plans for Grandview Heights include the North Grandview Heights NCP (land uses for the neighbourhoods north of 28 Avenue from King George Boulevard to Highway 15) and the Morgan Heights NCP (the first urban residential neighbourhood in Grandview Heights).

Where the condo stock concentrates: in the Morgan Crossing / Grandview Corners village ground at 24 Avenue / 160 Street — Croydon Drive and 26 Avenue addresses, residences above and beside the shops — inside the wider Grandview attached shelf.

Community context only (whole S Surrey White Rock community, not Grandview's prices): Detached median $1,628,000; Condos & Townhomes median $700,000 / $524 per sq ft / 99% sale-to-list / 33 DOM. Not this area's row, stated to prevent the error: Morgan Creek — Detached 45 / 5 / 11%; Condos & Townhomes 39 / 9 / 23%.
